Helpful answers

Common questions from new practice administrators.

How do I add a new provider to the schedule?

Open Team & roles, invite the provider with a Clinician role, then visit the calendar and set their weekly availability. They'll appear on the booking page within a few minutes of accepting their invite.

Can patients choose their own reminder cadence?
What happens when an integration disconnects?
Where is patient data stored?
Archived locations

Closed offices and merged sites.

Nothing in the archive
When you close or merge a location, it lands here. Records stay searchable for as long as your retention policy requires.
Careful, slow steps

These actions are permanent or affect every patient at once.

Pause all patient communication
Hold every outbound SMS, email, and voice call. Useful during a weather closure or system maintenance.
Pause sending
Export the full practice archive
Bundle all charts, billing history, and audit logs as encrypted ZIP. Available for 7 days after generation.
